dimensionReasons.reason: Neocenter is relevant to IP telephony, conferencing and hospitality communications, but packet evidence for routers, Wi-Fi and switching is limited.
Its specialist VAD and commercial-representative model gives strong vendor and reseller influence.
More than 2,000 reseller partners nationwide establish strong same-role coverage, although the count is dated 2017.
Partner portals, pre-sales training and broad communications brands support mature enablement.
Hospitality and communications adjacency is useful, but product-track depth and entrenched brands limit fit.

unsupportedOrContradictoryClaims: The 2,000-partner scale figure is historical rather than current.
